segments.an9.62:1.1: “Nava, bhikkhave, dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
segments.an9.62:1.3: Rāgaṃ, dosaṃ, mohaṃ, kodhaṃ, upanāhaṃ, makkhaṃ, paḷāsaṃ, issaṃ, macchariyaṃ – ime kho, bhikkhave, nava dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
segments.an9.62:2.1: “Nava, bhikkhave, dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
segments.an9.62:2.3: Rāgaṃ, dosaṃ, mohaṃ, kodhaṃ, upanāhaṃ, makkhaṃ, paḷāsaṃ, issaṃ, macchariyaṃ – ime kho, bhikkhave, nava dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātun”ti.
segments.an9.62:3.1: Khemo ca amatañceva, abhayaṃ passaddhiyena ca;
segments.an9.62:3.3: Nirodho anupubbo ca, dhammaṃ pahāya bhabbena cāti.
